title: Rave Reviews
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Activate / Kill

Quest Description: Head down into Level 7 of Balzack's Burrow and disable Abadunkadunkaddonna's D.D.R.-A Machine. Disable the Lighting Technician installing the device as well.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Afterparty

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Head down into Level 7 of Balzack's Burrow and disable Abadunkadunkaddonna's D.D.R.-A Machine. Disable the Lighting Technician installing the device as well.

Offer:

Troubling news, Runner. It looks like Abadunkadunkaddonna's Intepretive Dance Instructor suddenly up and left Balzack's Burrow and Abadunk...whatever, is none too happy. Abadunkad-a-whatsherface has taken another approach now and developed these new devices to hypnotize the Oroks into learning the new dances. She and Balzack are having this new Dynamically Demented Reality - Adjuster installed in Level 7 of Balzack's Burrow for a test run.

The latest information I've gotten shows they have not yet completed the installation. It seems there have been some technical difficulties and Balzack had to call in a Lighting Technician to take a look at it. Why not head down there and disable the D.D.R.-A machine. While you're at it, go ahead and disable the Technician as well.

When you are done, make sure to clean-up and report your progress to me, the Townston Commander, in Townston. Oh! And don't look directly into the D.D.R.-A machine, who knows what could happen.

Turn-in:

Back so soon? You didn't look directly into the D.D.R.-A machine did you? You don't have the sudden compulsion to do the Unholy Hokey Pokey, do you? Interpretive Dance? No?

I am never going to learn a new dance now!

Objectives:

  • Disable the D.D.R.-A Device ×1
  • Disable the Lighting Technician

Level range: 60–100
